messages:
Maya (PM): FYI Acme just pushed a firm ask: private deployment with HSM + reserved burst capacity. They want T+6 weeks. Need to triage scope and launch gates now.
Jun (Runtime): T+6 weeks is tight. Which model/version? perf SLA? will they accept a quantized 8-bit variant?
Maya (PM): Customer requires parity with hosted API token-level latency < 120ms p50 on short prompts. Model: open-llama-13B v2. MVP: no fine-tuning, just inference & embeddings.
Aria (Infra): HSM onboarding + network peering will add ~2 weeks of ops work (legal + infra + KMS whitelisting). Reserved burst GPUs depend on current pool - need capacity pin.
Sam (Security): HSM means we need key-rotation policy, threat-model signoff, and SOC artifacts. We also need a scoped pen-test window before cert. Those are gating — not optional.
Leo (SRE): From runtime side, prewarm + burst plan looks doable if we can pre-schedule warmup jobs. Canary rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h with rollback. Will add a small smoke harness.
Maya (PM): Ok — propose decision: MVP scope = inference endpoints + embeddings, HSM for keys, no cross-tenant caching. Launch gates = perf SLO, HSM onboarding, infra peering, security signoff, canary success. Agree? :eyes:
Jun (Runtime): Agree. Need to validate kv-cache disabled for private mode. Also need a quantization profile: run 2 runs (fp16 + int8) and surface quality diffs. I can run evals this week.
Aria (Infra): I'll book peering slots and open a capacity request. Estimate: 2x A100 equiv for reserved burst, monthly cost estimate incoming by EOD.
Sam (Security): I'll own the gating checklist. Quick ask: can we disallow external snapshotting by default? That avoids leakage risk.
Maya (PM): Disallow snapshotting for MVP makes sense. Add to launch checklist. Who will own test plan for perf?
Leo (SRE): Jun + I will own perf tests. I'll sketch the smoke job:
```
# smoke-run (k6-lite)
k6 run --vus 10 --duration 60s smoke.js --env ENDPOINT=https://private.acme.redwood/api
```
Jun (Runtime): I'll wire the smoke.js to sample lat/99 and token-costs. Also will run embedding regression against baseline.
Aria (Infra): Blocker: HSM vendor needs IP allowlist; legal needs contract amendments. I'll ping partnerships.
Sam (Security): Timeline note: pen-test window typically 10 business days. We can parallelize documentation signoff with infra work but testing still adds time.
Maya (PM): New proposed timeline: - Week 1: infra peering & HSM contract steps (Aria) - Week 1-2: runtime evals + quant profile (Jun) - Week 2-3: prewarm + reserved capacity provisioning (Aria/Leo) - Week 3: security pen-test + docs (Sam) - Week 4: canary + launch. That pushes to ~T+5 weeks optimistic. Anyone see major holes?
Jun (Runtime): Need model artifacts and tokenizer specs from customer day 0. Also accept rate-limiting policy for private endpoints?
Maya (PM): I'll ask Acme for artifacts and a perf test corpus. Rate-limit policy: start with tenant-level qps cap and escalate if needed.
DeployBot: scheduled: private-deploy-preview job for acme at 2024-10-05T18:30Z :rocket:
Sam (Security): Please add a short checklist item: ensure KMS keys are non-exportable and HSM attestation doc attached.
Leo (SRE): I'll draft the canary playbook and rollback script. Jun, can you provide a lightweight health-check route that validates kv cache status and tokenization?
Jun (Runtime): Yep — will add `/health?check=kv,token` and return json with kv_active=false for private mode.
Maya (PM): Great. Action items capture: 1) Maya -> get artifacts & perf corpus from Acme (D1) 2) Aria -> start HSM/vendor onboarding + peering (D2) 3) Jun -> quant evals + smoke harness (D3) 4) Sam -> start security checklist & pen-test scheduling (D3) 5) Leo -> canary playbook + rollback (D4). We'll run daily 11am stand for the next 2 weeks to unblock. :calendar: 
Aria (Infra): noted. I'll post capacity estimate card in #product by EOD.
Jun (Runtime): I'll post eval diffs and perf targets in this thread when ready.
Maya (PM): Thanks all — booking the daily. If anyone gets a hard no from legal/security on HSM we need to surface immediately.
Sam (Security): Will escalate early if anything blocks.
Maya (PM): Closing this thread for now — followups in the daily. :handshake:
